notes: Port-standard release (owner decree): the console's default port moves from 8790 to 19167 across the whole product — source, scripts, docs, the marketing site and the READMEs. The port is now a machine-local setting with one resolution chain (AIDOG_WEB_PORT env > web/port.local > the 19167 default), shared by the server, the boot/install/doctor scripts, the CKX backup caller and the desktop shell, so every component agrees on where the console listens. The console Settings card gained a Console-port row: it shows the running port and its source, and an operator can pin a new one behind the Bearer gate — the write validates the range, refuses a port another local service owns, refuses an active env override (which would silently win), pins web/port.local atomically, and honestly reports that a restart is required rather than re-binding mid-response. New GET /api/console reports the host, port, source and any pending restart as a loopback status surface. Profile ports now allocate above the new default (19168+). The smoke suite grew six legs covering the new read/write endpoints and now reports 438/438; the desktop port-chain test brings node --test to 16/16. Existing single-install machines migrate by updating the watchdog health URL and restarting the console, which re-resolves the port from the new default.
